d: Responsible for executing shutdowns, startups, and daily operations per established procedures and monitor plant parameters to report abnormalities. Additional duties include performing plant patrols, maintaining logs, overseeing maintenance activities, and ensuring compliance with safety protocols such as the PTW system and QHSE programs
q: Minimum a Technical degree or equivalent
Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in Industrial Processes, Mechanical, Chemical, Petroleum or equivalent
Strong troubleshooting, problem solving, information analysis and interpersonal skills.
Strong organizational skills with an ability to work under deadline commitments and pressure in both individual and team settings without supervision
Proficient in using Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, etc.), PC skills, and CMMS like SAP, Maximo, Oracle, etc.
Remote site working conditions, hot and humid climate, long working hours
r: Perform shutdowns and startup operations as per the guidelines set by the procedure and supervisors’
Pressurize & De-pressurize equipment and pipelines as and when requested/required
Monitor identity plant parameters, inform abnormalities, and inform the control room operator if any corrective action is necessary
Respond appropriately to plant emergencies according to ERP procedure
Patrol the plant area periodically at each shift to visually inspect all equipment
Review the pressure, delta pressure, temperature and level gauges of all equipment and report the abnormalities to the control room
Take gauge readings, analyze, and troubleshoot them as necessary
Ensure operations daily log is maintained and provide accurate verbal handovers to the on-coming shift members
Identify potential hazards, take immediate corrective action where possible, and report occurrences to the control room
Act as an Area Authority for PTW system for isolation for all routine planned and break-down maintenance
Check level/inventory of chemicals, consumables, etc., ensure they are at targeted rates and restored to normal levels
Monitor and conduct all operational process activities according to instructions and production requirements
Compile, complete, and submit all necessary reports and documents regarding production operations as required
Participate, collaborate, and update various orientations and QHSE programmes to update new changes/techniques
Check maintenance works and ensure systems are adequately conditioned to prevent current and future accidents and/or spills
Perform all isolation activities required for process equipment, pipelines, and vessels, and prepare certificates, permits, JHA, etc., to perform the job in a safe manner
Comply with all Enerflex HR, Quality, HSE, and all the Company policies, procedures, processes, work instructions and guidelines
Perform all other duties as assigned by Supervisor / Manager
